Deep-sea research is built on teamwork and joint effort, we also value collaborations with a wide institution and research partners. Close to 20% of our collected specimens are loaned to our partners to foster collaboration in the research community, and bringing taxonomic expertise together. These are:

- [University of Hamburg](https://www.uni-hamburg.de/en.html)
- [University of Iceland](https://english.hi.is)
- [Nord University](https://www.nord.no/en/about/study-locations/bodo)
- [The Arctic University of Norway (UiT)](https://en.uit.no/startsida)
- [Marine & Freshwater Research Institute](https://www.hafogvatn.is/en/)
- [Ifremer](https://www.ifremer.fr/en)
- [GEOMAR Helmholtz-Zentrum für Ozeanforschung Kiel](https://www.geomar.de)
- [University of Lodz](https://www.uni.lodz.pl/en/)
- [British Antarctic Survey](https://www.bas.ac.uk)

Some of our close collaborators are:

- [Prof. Dr. Bodil Bluhm](https://en.uit.no/ansatte/person?p_document_id=384289)
- [Prof. Dr. Henning Reiss](https://www.nord.no/en/about/employees/henning-reiss)
- [Dr. Katrin Linse](https://www.bas.ac.uk/profile/kl/)
- [Dr. Stefán Ragnarsson](https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Stefan-Ragnarsson)
- [Dr. Steinunn Ólafsdóttir](https://www.hafogvatn.is/is/midlun/utgafa/authors/steinunn-hilma-olafsdottir)
- [Laure de Montety](https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Laure-De-Montety)
- [Prof. Dr. Haseeb Randwana](https://english.hi.is/staff/hrandhawa)
- [Prof. Dr. Snæbjörn Pálsson](https://english.hi.is/staff/snaebj)
- [Dr. Halldór Halldórsson](https://english.hi.is/staff/halldor)

And the list keeps growing! Do you work in related research topics or have an idea for potential collaboration? Feel free to reach out!
